$comment: The bench separation manifest (the kernel reuse round, J224): every folder under bench/src and bench/test is KERNEL (a kernel benchmark: imports @plat/kernel and only the test kit's kernel parts), TOWN (imports layout/site/model/tables), or INFRA (harness: host, timing, tiers, calibration, scan/parity entries). tools/lint/bench-boundary.mjs (run by corepack pnpm lint) refuses an unlisted, doubly listed or absent folder and a KERNEL folder whose files import a town package. A new bench folder is classified here in the change that adds it.
